no_access_title: Payments are for org owners and admins
no_access_body: Ask an owner of this organization if you need access.

connect.title: Payout account
connect.agreement_required: Accept the donation agreement before connecting a payout account.
connect.agreement_first: Accept the current donation agreement first.
connect.not_eligible: This organization is not yet eligible to accept donations.
connect.owner_only: Only the organization's owner can change payout settings.
connect.blocked_reason: Stripe has blocked this account ({{reason}}). Contact civfix support.
connect.blocked_generic: Stripe has blocked this account. Contact civfix support.
connect.state_not_started: No payout account yet. Connect one to accept donations.
connect.state_onboarding: Stripe still needs some details before this account can take payments.
connect.state_at_risk: Stripe needs more information soon, or payouts may pause.
connect.state_blocked: This account cannot accept donations right now.

return.toast_body: Stripe confirms accounts in the background. We are checking.
return.pending: Waiting for Stripe to confirm. This can take a minute.

refresh.toast_body: Start setup again to get a fresh link.

eligibility.title: Nonprofit eligibility
eligibility.remediation_grace: Resolve the California registry listing before the grace period ends, or donations will stop.
eligibility.remediation_ineligible: Donations cannot be enabled until the organization's nonprofit status is restored.
eligibility.remediation_review_required: civfix is reviewing this organization. We will be in touch.
eligibility.remediation_unknown: Eligibility has not been checked yet. This runs automatically.

agreement.title: Donation agreement
agreement.body_who: Your organization is the recipient and the merchant of record. civfix never holds your funds.
agreement.body_fees: civfix charges a disclosed platform fee on each donation. Your organization pays the payment processor's own fees.
agreement.body_duties: You confirm the organization's nonprofit status, tell civfix within five business days if it changes, and remain responsible for receipts, refunds and tax reporting.
agreement.check_accept: I accept this agreement on behalf of the organization.
agreement.check_authority: I am authorized to accept it on the organization's behalf.
agreement.owner_only: Only the organization's owner can accept this.
agreement.drift: The agreement was updated while this was open. Reload and read the new version.

settings.title: Donation settings
settings.enable_caption: Shows a donate button on your organization and event pages.
settings.enable_unavailable: Donations cannot be turned on until the payout account is ready, the organization is eligible, and the current agreement is accepted.
settings.operator_locked: civfix disabled donations for this organization. Contact support.
settings.owner_only: Only the organization's owner can change this.
settings.blocker_account: The payout account is not ready.
settings.blocker_agreement: The current donation agreement has not been accepted.
settings.blocker_operator: civfix disabled donations for this organization.
settings.fee_disclosure: civfix charges {{percent}}% of each donation. Your organization also pays the payment processor's fees. Donors always see the full breakdown before they pay.
settings.refund_policy_hint: Shown to donors before they pay.
settings.sharing_default_caption: Donors always choose. This only sets which way the checkbox starts, and it starts off by law.
settings.refund_policy_error: A refund policy cannot say that 100% of a donation reaches the organization: the payment processor's fee is always deducted, and the donate page shows the real split.

report.title: Donations
report.donor_identity_note: A donor's name and email appear only where they chose to share them. Everything else is an anonymous donation.
report.empty_body: Donations appear here as soon as someone gives.
report.loaded_pages_note: Covers only the rows loaded on screen when this file was generated, not the full history.

exports.title: Donation exports
exports.hint: A CSV of the organization's whole donation ledger, not only the rows on screen.
exports.requested_hint: It appears below as soon as it is ready.
exports.empty_body: Request one and it will appear here.
exports.note: An export carries donor names and emails wherever donors chose to share them. The download link is short-lived and the file is deleted when it expires.
